sources.title: Official Mistral-Nemotron model card in Markdown
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 retrieval of the full linked Markdown card returned HTTP 200. It identifies a Mistral-produced, NVIDIA-optimized text model, v1, released June 11, 2025, with a modified Transformer and 128K context. The complete architecture, benchmark and capability sections give neither a total nor an activated-parameter count and do not identify a named base model from which a nominal count could be inferred. Reasoning and function calling remain explicitly supported. The web renderer failed on this URL; the raw Markdown was read successfully.

sources.title: Official endpoint page and embedded endpoint specification
sources.evidence: The indexed catalog names Mistral AI as provider and marks downloadable weights unavailable. Raw page endpoint metadata identifies mistralai/mistral-nemotron and explicitly sets modelCapability.functionCalling=true and reasoning=true; the playground enables reasoning by default. Its deprecation notice says API deprecated September 27, 2026 and unsupported after September 28. The embedded OpenAPI schema omits tools and reasoning controls and contains an MIT label linked to an inaccessible HF LICENSE; neither overrides the model card’s explicit licensing requirements. No endpoint inference was attempted.

sources.title: June 11, 2025 NVIDIA announcement
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The June 11, 2025 announcement calls Mistral Nemotron a new Mistral model, jointly optimized for inference and exclusively available through NVIDIA AI Enterprise. It gives no parameter count or relationship to a named count-bearing base model.

sources.title: Mistral partner-served deployment terms
sources.evidence: Current terms, effective May 28, 2026, grant limited access/use of Mistral products through partners, retain Mistral ownership, and require confidentiality for weights made available through Specific Access. The exact card directs deployments to acquire Mistral licenses; proprietary is a descriptive classification, not a claim that these are public open-weight terms.

sources.title: License URL referenced by embedded endpoint OpenAPI
sources.evidence: HTTP 401 during direct retrieval; no license text obtained. The OpenAPI MIT label is not treated as proof of an MIT weight release.

sources.title: Mistral official-organization exact-name model search
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 exact-name official-organization API search returned HTTP 200 and an empty list. This supplies no count or lineage; it does not establish that no private repository exists. The earlier direct repository request returned HTTP 401.

sources.title: NVIDIA official-organization exact-name model search
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 exact-name official-organization API search returned HTTP 200 and an empty list. Differently named Mistral-NeMo-Minitron repositories do not establish this endpoint's total or active counts.

sources.title: Current Mistral models and publication index
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The current model and publication index contains counts for other named Mistral releases but does not identify the June 2025 Mistral-Nemotron endpoint as one of them. Fresh exact-name searches for total/active parameters, named bases and fine-tuning across Mistral, NVIDIA documentation and arXiv located no count-bearing original report or comparison for this exact model. Search coverage is not proof that no disclosure exists.

sources.title: March 2026 Mistral-NVIDIA coalition announcement
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The March 16, 2026 announcement describes a planned co-developed base model underpinning the upcoming Nemotron 4 family, explicitly building on prior Mistral NeMo collaboration. It does not identify that future model or Mistral NeMo as the base of the June 2025 Mistral-Nemotron endpoint, and supplies no count for this record.

sources.title: HTML model-card route and Markdown alternate link
sources.evidence: Direct HTML retrieval exposes only a shell plus an explicit alternate text/markdown link to s1. Full card content was obtained through that linked Markdown representation; missing HTML rendering is not represented as missing primary documentation.

sources.title: October 21, 2026 Mistral-NVIDIA partnership update
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 reading of this later announcement distinguishes the prior Mistral NeMo collaboration, the frontier base model being developed through the Nemotron Coalition, and the separate Mistral Large 4 preview with its own total/active counts. It gives no count or named lineage for the June 2025 Mistral-Nemotron endpoint; those other model counts are not transferred.

sources.title: Current NVIDIA NIM LLM API directory
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The directory lists the exact mistralai/mistral-nemotron route but no parameter counts. Both its model and inference documentation links currently redirect to the API documentation home page, so they provide no additional architecture or base-model evidence. The original full Build Markdown card remains available.

sources.title: Unsubstantiated third-party 70B lead
sources.evidence: Reopened solely to evaluate the existing 70B lead. The page gives 70B without a supporting model card, technical report or named lineage, and incorrectly dates release to December 1, 2025 rather than the original June 11 announcement/card. It is not adopted as parameter evidence and contains no active count.

name.note: Display punctuation normalized from the exact official Mistral-Nemotron name; wire identifier is mistralai/mistral-nemotron.

developer.note: The exact card explicitly says Mistral produced the model and that NVIDIA did not develop or own it. NVIDIA optimized inference and hosts the route. Correct the developer attribution; preserve the frozen catalog record ID.

family.note: Retains the catalog’s Nemotron name grouping, supported by this model’s official name; it does not imply NVIDIA authorship or the architecture of NVIDIA’s other Nemotron families.

release_date.note: Exact card declares this Build release date, independently corroborated by the same-day NVIDIA announcement of the new model. June 12 is the page update date, not the release.

open_weights.note: Official catalog marks downloads unavailable and the card requires acquiring licenses from Mistral for deployment/customization. No public exact-model checkpoint was found; private licensed weight access is distinct from open weights.

license.note: Exact card requires NVIDIA trial terms for the hosted API and a Mistral license for deployment. Embedded API-schema MIT metadata points to an inaccessible file and is not substantiated as a model-weight license. Use the descriptive proprietary classification.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review found no published nominal total or explicit relationship to a named count-bearing base in the original card, launch, current documentation or later first-party announcements. The unattributed third-party 70B claim remains unsupported. Counts for NeMo, Minitron, Mistral Large 4 or the future Nemotron 4 coalition model do not identify this June 2025 endpoint.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model searches found no original benchmark table, plot or developer specification reporting activated parameters for this endpoint. The card does not establish dense versus MoE structure or a named base; no active count can be inferred from family names or unrelated models. This null reflects missing published evidence, not a requirement for an exact tensor census.

architecture.note: Exact card explicitly specifies Transformer / Modified Transformer. It does not disclose whether layers are dense or sparse MoE, nor block dimensions; transformer is the supported classification.

context_window.note: The card specifies a 128K maximum context for input/output. Retains the catalog’s decimal normalization to 128000; source does not establish a precise 131072-token configuration or a separate output allowance.

modalities.note: The exact card explicitly specifies text-string input and output.

reasoning.note: Current exact-model capabilities explicitly mark reasoning supported and endpoint playground metadata enables reasoning by default. This supports true without inferring from math benchmarks; no controllable reasoning budget or API toggle is claimed.

tool_call.note: The exact card describes tool calling and its capability metadata explicitly enables function calling. Embedded OpenAPI schema does not expose tools fields, so record documented model capability without claiming a tested currently operational tool endpoint.

description.value: Mistral AI text model optimized by NVIDIA for instruction following, coding, translation, summarization and tool use.
description.note: Plain description follows the exact model card and official endpoint description, with correct developer and optimization roles.

patch.description: Mistral AI text model optimized by NVIDIA for instruction following, coding, translation, summarization and tool use.
patch.notes: Mistral AI developed this model; NVIDIA optimized and hosted it. The official card describes a modified Transformer with 128K context; total and active counts, dense/MoE structure and a named count-bearing base remain undisclosed. NeMo, Minitron and the later Nemotron coalition models do not establish this endpoint's size. Public weights are unavailable; deployment requires a Mistral license. The embedded API schema’s MIT label is not backed by an accessible license. Current capability metadata marks reasoning and function calling supported, but NVIDIA’s page also says this API was deprecated September 27, 2026 and unsupported after September 28; current endpoint operation was not tested. The catalog ID retains its original provider-based prefix.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit retains explicit null total and active counts: the original June 2025 card and launch, official repository searches, current API/research indexes and later partnership announcements supply no exact-model count or supported named lineage. The third-party 70B lead is unsubstantiated. The twelve other audited fields and prior corrections are preserved.
